_doc: Weapon tuning (docs/WEAPONS.md). Damage per pellet. Times in seconds. Falloff: full to start m, linear to min at end m. Gun feel and viewmodel framing: see "feel" (per-weapon overrides go in a row's "feel" object).

coal_shovel._doc: Jakub's coal shovel from the Old Cellar (U02 section 6.2): the companion's weak melee while he has no gun. Never a wall-buy.
coal_shovel.name: Coal Shovel

feel._doc: Gun feel + viewmodel framing (WeaponHolder.feel_for). Resolution: classes.default < classes[<class>] < base weapon row 'feel' < upgraded row 'feel'. viewmodel_fov: the guns are drawn as if at this vertical FOV whatever the FOV setting. Camera recoil per shot: cam_pitch deg up, cam_yaw deg random +-, cam_keep = share that stays in your aim (rest springs back at cam_recover rad/s), ads_recoil multiplier while aimed. Viewmodel kick on a damped spring (vm_spring rad/s, vm_damp ratio): vm_back m, vm_lift share of vm_back, vm_climb deg, vm_roll deg, ads_kick multiplier. shake / fov_punch (deg) scale with the Screen Shake setting. flash_light energy, flash_time s, smoke puff (smoke_k size), casing pistol|rifle|shell|none, fire_db. Poses (camera space, m / deg): hip, hip_rot, sprint_pos, sprint_rot, reload_pos, reload_rot (x reload_tilt), sprint_reload_pose = the share of the sprint pose kept while reloading on the run (T-083, default 0.35), ADS (T-047): eye_relief = metres from the eye to the model's SightPoint marker when aimed (the gun is placed so SightPoint and FrontSight sit on the screen center); ads_zoom = camera FOV multiplier when fully aimed (per weapon, class value as the fallback); the weapon row's 'sway' scales ADS sway (turn lag + figure-8), ads_sway_mult scales it further. sway_mult, bob_mult.

walther_p38._doc: Muster sidearm (T-079): a sidegrade of the M1911 at round 1. Less damage, faster follow-up and reload, tighter hip fire.

webley._doc: Muster sidearm (T-079): a break-open .455 revolver. Hits nearly twice as hard as the M1911, six rounds, slow and fixed reload, through one zombie.

luger_p08._doc: Muster sidearm (T-079): accurate and quick to aim, its damage carries further; slower to reload.

recoil._doc: Aim recoil patterns (Update 02 §1, WeaponHolder._apply_recoil_pattern), separate from the viewmodel's visual kick (feel.vm_*) and the camera's punch spring (feel.cam_* x punch, which springs fully back). Resolution: classes.default < classes[<class>] < weapons[<base id>] < a weapon row's "recoil". Shot i of a burst moves the aim up v x min(v_max_mult, 1 + v_growth x i) deg and sideways h_swing x sin(i x h_freq + per-weapon phase) +- random h deg (x feel.ads_recoil when aimed, x crouch_mult crouched). After recover_delay s without a shot, (1 - keep) of the burst drifts back at recover (1/s); the shot index resets after reset s. Hip bloom: + bloom deg a shot (pellet guns 35%), up to bloom_max; it holds while firing, then shrinks at bloom_still deg/s standing still, bloom_move moving, x1.4 crouched.
